<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
const pgTrack = ref(null)
const pgIdx = ref(0)
const pgNames = ['GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra', 'Muse Image']
function pgOnScroll(e) {
  const el = e.target
  if (el && el.clientWidth) pgIdx.value = Math.round(el.scrollLeft / el.clientWidth)
}
function pgGo(i) {
  const el = pgTrack.value
  if (el) el.scrollTo({ left: i * el.clientWidth, behavior: 'smooth' })
}

const pg2Track = ref(null)
const pg2Idx = ref(0)

function pg2OnScroll(e) {
  const el = e.target

}
function pg2Go(i) {
  const el = pg2Track.value
  if (el) el.scrollTo({ left: i * el.clientWidth, behavior: 'smooth' })
}
</script>
